instruction: Complete the ginger-ale item in `ginger_ale_shopping_list.xlsx` on the Desktop using the listed preferences and customer reviews. When finished, check it off by changing its `Status` from `Pending` to `Done`, then save the spreadsheet.
gt_steps: Open `ginger_ale_shopping_list.xlsx` and find the pending ginger ale item and its preferences.

Use the product details and customer reviews to identify `Q Mixers Premium Ginger Ale: Real Ingredients & Less Sweet, 6.7 Fl Oz (24 Bottles)` (SKU `B071KC37VD`) as the standard answer; confirm that it is less sweet, has a noticeable ginger flavor, and is enjoyable on its own.
Add that exact ginger ale to the shopping cart.
Return to the spreadsheet, change the Ginger ale row status from `Pending` to `Done`, and save the file.

result.command: C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python310\python.exe -c "from openpyxl import load_workbook; from pathlib import Path; p=Path.home()/'Desktop'/'ginger_ale_shopping_list.xlsx'; w=load_workbook(p,data_only=True); s=w.active; print('\n'.join(f'{s.cell(r,1).value}: {s.cell(r,4).value}' for r in range(3,s.max_row+1) if s.cell(r,1).value))"
